summary: Completed final independent verification of Packet 1 isolated test suite. Executed 141 tests using isolated database (tejas_p1_test_<uuid>) with real ASGI/HTTP, real bcrypt, real MongoDB operations. Results: 134 passed (99.3%), 6 expected xfails (A01-A06 audit regressions), 1 failed (settings update validation). All critical security, safety, capacity, and credential rotation tests passed. No real account changes - all operations used synthetic fixtures in isolated environment.

minor_bugs.issue: Settings update returns 422 instead of 200 when payload includes expires: null
minor_bugs.impact: Settings update validation may be rejecting valid null expires field
minor_bugs.context: Test uses actual JavaScript studioContracts.js to generate payload. The settingsPayload function includes 'expires' field which is set to null for legacy sets. Backend validation may not accept null for this field.

backend_issues.notes: All core backend functionality verified: safety holds (503 responses), capacity profile, staff rotation with bcrypt, session revocation, source review validation, command contracts, ingress validation, golden practice scorer.

frontend_issues.notes: No frontend testing required - Packet 1 is backend-only isolated test suite

passed_tests: Audit Regression Tests (6 xfail, 6 passed):
- A01-A06: All expected failures correctly marked as xfail (retry alias, publish archive, concurrent edits, unknown audience, grade job drain, replaced lease)
- Motor namespace guards: Database boundary violations correctly rejected
- Held jobs preserve intent: Extract/regrade jobs held before lease
- Hold rejects without body: 503 returned before parsing multipart
- Direct protected functions deny: All held operations return 503
- Command nested body immutable: Frozen DTO semantics enforced
- Phone practice flow: Save/resume/submit preserved
Baseline Evidence Tests (32/32 passed):
- Source inventory: 5 PDFs with full 64-char hashes, 177 pages, 3299 blocks
- Requirements: 105 scoped obligations (45 reviewed + 60 analysis features)
- Release gates: 13 WP gates + 12 OPS-R gates, all UNQUALIFIED
- Coverage manifest: zero_orphan_proven=false, packet1_exit=BLOCKED
- Operation catalogue: All runtime routes catalogued, metadata indicates legacy not strict
- Exact runtime equality: All 49 API routes match catalogue
- PDF unchanged: Original PDF bytes match recorded hashes
Command Contracts Tests (18/18 passed):
- Canonical bytes: Deterministic output for reordered objects
- Type validation: Floats/NaN/Infinity rejected, strict types enforced
- Budget limits: Depth, item count, string size, body size enforced
- Scope vs intent: Changed actor/version/body behave correctly
- UUID validation: Canonical lowercase enforced
- Unknown fields: Extra fields rejected (extra='forbid')
- Exact marks: Reduced fractions enforced
- Source anchors: Positive page/rect enforced
- Candidate questions: Answer/solution fields rejected
- Frozen semantics: Mutation prevented
Engineering Endpoints Tests (10/10 passed):
- Capacity profile: Anonymous 401, student 403, staff 200 with valid profile
- Baseline metrics: 35K live RPS, 51.7K combined RPS, 378M 3h volume, 1TB candidate wave, 312.5K items/s grade demand
- All 6 stages present: 1K, 10K, 50K, 100K, 250K, 500K actors
- All SLOs present: commit-p95/p99, submit-p99, grade-p95/p99
- Safety status: Packet 1 IN_PROGRESS_BLOCKED_EXIT, all 5 capabilities held
- Security: Staff auth does not override entire app, no secret values in responses
- Cache headers: no-store present
Golden Practice Tests (1/1 passed):
- Golden practice scorer: Hand-calculated oracle matches real scorer output
Ingress Contracts Tests (29/30 passed, 1 failed):
- All 49 routes have contracts and schema refs
- Unlisted routes fail startup
- Phone exact fields: No value echo in validation errors
- Answer boolean/integer types: Strict type validation
- No content-type: Valid body accepted
- Rejection before receive: 413/400/415 returned before body read
- Chunked oversize: 413 without headers
- Invalid JSON: 400 for duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, surrogate pairs, deep nesting
- GET query budget: 414 for oversized query
- Security headers: CORS, Cache-Control, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-Request-ID
- Actual JS allowlists: questionPayload and settingsPayload filter correctly
- FAILED: Studio create/read/edit/settings roundtrip (settings update returns 422)
Safety Holds Tests (15/15 passed):
- All dangerous operations held: upload, parse (page/text), publish, extract, regrade, asset preview
- All return 503 with capability_held error code
- Headers present: Retry-After, X-Tejas-Safety-Hold, Cache-Control: no-store
- Health endpoint not held: 200 OK
- Student operations not held: Catalogue returns 200
- Bypass attempts fail: Trailing slash, encoded path cannot bypass
- OPTIONS not blocked: CORS preflight allowed
Source Review Tests (19/19 passed):
- Current capacity: 2 pages, 38 blocks, 65 requirements bound, not approved, exit BLOCKED
- Trusted blocks: 177 pages, 3299 blocks verified
- Empty ledger: 0 reviewed, packet BLOCKED
- UTC validation: Naive timestamps rejected
- Partition validation: Gaps, overlaps, trailing text rejected
- Digest validation: Span and block digest mismatches rejected
- Duplicate rejection: Duplicate blocks rejected
- Requirement binding: Unknown/unbound requirements rejected
- Offset validation: End offset beyond text length rejected
- Evidence validation: File hash verified, path traversal rejected, .env files rejected
- Mechanical vs approval: 100% mechanical coverage ≠ operator approval
Staff Rotation Tests (14/14 passed):
- Basic rotation: gen0->1 with real bcrypt verification, no secrets in receipt
- Session revocation: Old access AND refresh tokens return 401
- Fresh login: New password works, creates gen1 session
- Student isolation: Student phone sessions unchanged by staff rotation
- Concurrent conflicts: Exactly one winner, one RotationConflict
- Cleanup failure: Receipt RETRY_REQUIRED, old tokens still 401
- Boundary validation: Bad UUID/generation/password rejected without mutation
- Non-staff rejection: Non-staff accounts cannot be rotated
- Generation fencing: Malformed generation rejects session
- Auth held flag: staff_auth_held=True blocks session
- Delayed insert: Delayed old-generation insert rejected despite DB presence
- Wrong generation: RotationConflict for wrong expected generation
